insight: Founded in 2009 in Ternopil, Ukraine; localizes Minecraft, Khan Academy and 3M+ accounts' worth of projects.
name: Crowdin
tagline: AI localization platform for software, docs, and content.
description: Crowdin is a translation-management platform that automates localizing apps, websites, games, and documentation. Strings flow in through 700+ integrations and 100+ file formats, then get translated via crowdsourcing, translation memory, and AI/machine-translation suggestions, with branching and an API/CLI to keep localization in sync with the codebase. Crowdin Enterprise adds data residency, SSO, and custom workflows.

modelSupport.notes: AI translation routes to OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic models; AI usage is billed at the providers' direct API rates with no Crowdin markup.

edge: Passes AI translation through at the provider's raw API rate (no markup), and is free for open-source and personal projects.
pros: AI billed at provider rates, no markup
Free for open-source and personal use
cons: Per-string/seat costs add up at scale
